seo.description: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu by Snibe: 278 parameters in 22 groups, searchable by assay name. Explore assays and MAGLUMI analyzer series in the LabWell catalog.

C1_hero.h1: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu — 278 parameters from Snibe
C1_hero.lead: The MAGLUMI CLIA test menu is Snibe's list of parameters for chemiluminescence immunoassay testing. According to Snibe, the menu covers 278 parameters across 22 groups; assay names are reproduced verbatim from the manufacturer.
